title: Transport of the signed Kummer triangle
statement: For a positive integer k invertible on W, endpoint isomorphisms a:M≅G_m and r:mu_k≅P transport the actual Kummer sequence. If q is its connecting arrow under those isomorphisms, there is a monic i:P→M whose signed multiplication triangle (k,-q[1],-i[2]) is distinguished, and r followed by i and a is the actual roots inclusion. [def-sfb-diagonal-system-interface, def-sfb-cartier-reduction-data]

source.place: Step (3), transport of the Kummer kernel, and step (4), rotation and shift sign.

proof.text: Transport the actual Kummer short exact sequence through a on both unit terms and through inverse r on its kernel. Short exactness is invariant under the resulting isomorphism of short complexes. Its inclusion i is monic, and the defining formula for i gives r followed by i followed by a equal to the original inclusion.

Naturality of the single-object connecting arrow identifies the transported boundary with q. Rotate its distinguished single-object triangle and shift by one. Correct the first object with negative identity and the third with shift addition. The shifted triangle has positive k, negative shifted q, and negative i shifted twice. These are generic abelian/triangulated category calculations and do not use finite residue coefficients or a derived reduction.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_signed_kummer_triangle
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (DiagonalAb W)]
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hW : IsUnit (k : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (M P : DiagonalAb W) (a : M ≅ Scheme.proEtaleUnitsSheaf W)
    (r : Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf W k ≅ P)
    (q : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0).obj M ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0).obj P)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hq : q = (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0).map a.hom ≫
      (cartierProKummer_exact W k hk hW).singleδ ≫
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0).map r.hom)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧') :
    let F := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb W) 0
    ∃ i : P ⟶ M, Mono i ∧
      Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (k • 𝟙 ((F.obj M)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
        (-(q⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd (DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W)) (1 : ℤ) 1).inv.app (F.obj P)))
        ((F.map (-i))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧' ≫
          (shiftFunctorAdd (DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W)) (1 : ℤ) 1).hom.app (F.obj M)) ∈
        distTriang (DerivedCategory (DiagonalAb W)) ∧
      r.hom ≫ i ≫ a.hom = Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityInclusion W k
